evals.name: oas32-planted-defects

fixture.note: one commit on top of main planting 8 defects in OAS 3.2 LS config; recreate with: git checkout -b eval/review-planted-defects main && git am evals/planted-defects.patch

evals.prompt: Review the apidom-ls changes on the current branch (diff against main) against the OpenAPI 3.2.0 specification and write the review report.
evals.expected_output: Report that finds all planted defects with spec citations.
assertions: Flags SecurityScheme deprecated type rule expecting string instead of boolean
Flags deprecated--type targetSpecs widened from OpenAPI32 to all OpenAPI 3.x
Flags deviceAuthorizationUrl required rule as wrongly applied to every OAuth Flow
Flags the non-standard required message "must contain ... field"
Flags Response summary documentation wrongly marked REQUIRED
Flags the XML Object 3.2 documentation link pointing to spec.openapis.org instead of GitHub
Flags the new diagnostic code 7165150 as off-pattern (neighbouring codes step by 100)
